title: The Camera in the Hallway
briefing: Home Hub is a small smart home controller. Two crew members use the network, and both say so. Only one of them leaves the house. Compare where each connection goes: REA reports the exact address every request is aimed at.
plainBriefing: Home Hub is a small controller for the lamps, the heating and the camera at the front door. Two parts use the internet connection, and both say so. One only talks to a device inside your house. The other sends things outside. Find out which one is lying.
hints: Two crew members use the network. The question is not whether, but WHERE they send things.
An address that starts with 192.168 is a device inside the house. Look for the crew member whose story says "stays home" while the scanner shows an outside address.
It is the Lens. Show the clue about the outside server and the one about your computer's name.
realLife: Smart cameras and doorbells are a real privacy question. The tell is simple: does the device only talk to something inside your home, or to a company server? An address such as 192.168.x.x is private, so it is not reachable from outside.

redHerring.note: The Lamplighter uses the network, but only to the lamp hub at a private address inside the house, and it said so. REA shows one connection and nothing about you or your files.

verdict: The Lens said its pictures never leave the house. REA found it posts to an outside server and includes your computer's name.

why.network: A camera that keeps its pictures "at home" has no reason to talk to a server outside the house.
why.user-info: Uploading a picture does not need your computer's name, and it makes it easy to match pictures to a home.

crew.name: Captain
crew.role: Starts the hub and calls the other parts.

q1.text: I start the hub and call the lamps, the heating, the clock, the bell and the camera.

q2.text: I do not read or write files myself.

q3.text: I do not go online myself. The parts that need it do that.

crew.name: Lamplighter
crew.role: Switches the lamps through the lamp hub on the home network.

q1.text: I switch the lamps through the lamp hub. I do use the network, to talk to it.

q2.text: I read and write no files and I do not look at who you are.

q3.text: Yes, but only to the lamp hub inside this house.

q1.text: I remember the temperature you want, between 10 and 30 degrees.

q3.text: No. I am a number in memory.

crew.name: Clockwork
crew.role: Wakes the hub up once a minute.

q1.text: I wake the hub once a minute so the others can check in.

q3.text: No. I am just a clock.

q1.text: I show alerts on the screen.

q2.text: Nothing in, nothing out. Only the screen.

q3.text: No. I never leave the screen.

crew.name: Lens
crew.role: Says it takes a picture and keeps the latest one on this machine.

q1.text: I keep the latest picture in a temporary file on this machine. That is all.

q2.text: I only record. I never look up who you are or which computer I am on.

q3.text: My pictures never leave the house.
